coverage_claim: WM-ECO-031 covers a governed Payroll / Compensation aggregate through separate payroll-run and payee-result identities, periods, parties, jurisdiction profiles, compensation terms, source inputs, calculations, bases, deductions, contributions, net pay, external payment and reporting bindings, lifecycle controls, corrections, reconciliation, provenance, privacy, access and loss-aware projections. Relation, worker-class, jurisdiction, labour, tax, benefit, accounting, implementation-conformance and independent-review questions remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The slash label is resolved as a payroll execution and compensation-result aggregate. It owns payroll runs and independently governed payee calculation results, while compensation plans and agreements, workers, time, benefits, payments, filings and ledgers remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: The model owns calculation and control context, not the full employment or compensation-plan lifecycle. Payroll run and payee result remain separate identities within the aggregate.
The unified registry supplies WM-ORG-005 as a parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-031 edge, so it grants no containment or cascade authority.
A run groups periods, rules, controls and totals; each result preserves its own worker binding, components, values, states, access and correction lineage.

decisions.concept: Compensation term, source input and calculated value
decisions.rationale: A term defines possible remuneration, an input evidences work or eligibility and a calculation derives values under pinned rules; none silently proves another.

decisions.concept: Regular, supplemental, off-cycle, final, advance, retroactive, correction, reversal and void
decisions.rationale: Each class has different periods, authority, tax treatment, lineage and downstream effects and cannot be inferred from timing or sign alone.

decisions.concept: Gross earnings, statutory bases, deductions, contributions, net pay and employer cost
decisions.rationale: Every value preserves amount type, component, currency, unit, rule version, period, source, precision and derivation and cannot prove another value.

decisions.concept: Calculated, validated, approved, released, paid, settled, filed, accepted, reconciled and closed
decisions.rationale: Calculation and payroll authorization do not prove execution or acceptance by payment, tax, benefit, accounting or reporting systems.

decisions.concept: Payment, statement, filing, remittance and ledger records
decisions.rationale: Payroll may create projections and record returned evidence but does not own bank accounts, payment settlement, authority filings, remittance settlement or accounting postings.

decisions.concept: Retroactive adjustment, correction, reversal and void
decisions.rationale: Corrections preserve the original calculation and source evidence, state the reason and authority and declare downstream payment, filing and ledger impacts.

decisions.concept: Jurisdiction, worker class, labour, tax, benefit and garnishment rules
decisions.rationale: International and national sources define scoped regimes; no rate, threshold, entitlement or deduction rule is universal.
Worker identity, compensation, bank destination, tax, benefit, garnishment, absence and performance facts require purpose-bound least-privilege access and auditable exceptions.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-031 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Slash-boundary hold: this aggregate covers payroll execution and compensation results, while compensation plans, agreements, equity administration and non-payroll rewards may require separate canonical models.
Relation hold: WM-ORG-005 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-031 edge.
Identity hold: payroll run, payee result, compensation term, time record, benefit, payment, statement, filing, remittance, ledger entry, dispute and records object remain distinct.
Class hold: regular, supplemental, off-cycle, final, advance, retroactive, correction, reversal and void processing require explicit classes and lineage.

Value hold: earning component, gross, taxable, pensionable and insurable bases, deductions, employer contributions, net pay, employer cost and statistical labour cost remain separately sourced and currency qualified.
Lifecycle hold: calculated, validated, approved, released, paid, settled, filed, accepted, reconciled and closed states do not prove one another.
Correction hold: retroactive adjustment, correction, reversal and void preserve originals and declare downstream obligations rather than overwriting history.
Privacy hold: worker identifiers, pay, bank, tax, benefit, garnishment, absence, performance and dispute data require purpose limitation, least privilege and minimum disclosure.
Source-access hold: ILO, US DOL, Canada CRA, Australia ATO, OECD and ISO sources had automated-access limitations or bounded timeouts and were verified through official indexed content.

Profile hold: employee, contractor, executive, equity, tips, piecework, commission, bonus, expense, household, agricultural, migrant, public-sector, multi-jurisdiction and multi-currency uses need separate profiles.

Interoperability hold: every labour, tax, payroll, payment, reporting, statistical, privacy, currency, temporal, provenance, quality, policy and API projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: payroll, compensation, labour, tax, benefits, garnishment, payments, accounting, privacy, audit and independent external review are outstanding.
deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-ORG-005 parent signal and register relations to worker, engagement, organization, job, position, timekeeping, leave, expense, sales, performance, benefit, tax, payment, bank account, ledger, filing, dispute and records models.
Evaluate separate canonical compensation-plan, equity-compensation, payroll-run and payee-result models while preserving this aggregate as an assembly.

Create employee, contractor, executive, equity, tips, piecework, commission, bonus, reimbursement, household, agricultural, seafarer, migrant, public-sector, multi-jurisdiction and multi-currency profiles.

Benchmark and conformance-test eligibility, proration, overtime, minimum wage, taxable and contribution bases, deduction priorities, ceilings, floors, accumulators, rounding, balancing, retroactivity and correction mappings.
Validate jurisdiction, labour, worker-classification, tax, social-insurance, pension, benefit, garnishment, privacy, payment, accounting, insolvency, audit and retention policies.

Pin exact external releases and obtain independent payroll, compensation, labour, tax, benefits, payments, accounting, privacy, audit and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
